appDescription: An in-car errand agent that plans today's errands into one route with shops, order, time and parking.

function.name: PLAN_TODAY_ROUTE
function.description: Plan today's schedules and errands into a single driving route and brief the driver.

homeBy.description: Time the driver wants to be home, in HH:mm format. Optional.

function.name: ADD_ERRAND
function.description: Add an errand such as buying an item or visiting a kind of shop to today's route and re-plan it.

item.description: Item to buy or kind of place to visit, e.g. cake, flowers, pharmacy.

function.name: GET_NEXT_STOP
function.description: Tell the driver the next stop of today's route and the expected arrival time.
